prompt: Going to University is thought by many to be the best way to secure a good job, on the other hand, some people think that getting work experience and getting a skill is more important. Discuss both sides and give your own opinion.
essay:
In recent years, the question of whether students should go for higher studies or focus on hands-on experiences has become widely debated. Some believe higher qualifications make once carrier more secure, other argues that real-world skills are vital. This essay discusses both viewpoints and explains why I stand with one perspective.

On the one hand, I do agree individual who have advanced education are more likely to achieve success in life for several reasons. Studies help humans become confident and motivated, and give them the opportunity to adapt and build management skills. Moreover, Universities provides in depth studies and specilization on perticular skill which ultimately helps professionals get into rewarding careers. To give a better example, 70 per cent of college graduates are earning more than non-graduates. Also, large firms give more importance to higer educations. Such as, hiring rates at Google are 79 per cent higher for applicants who have greater education.

On the other hand, so argues that hands-on experience is really necessary and rewarding in the real world. When a person enters the workforce, it does help to build their communication, negotiation, and teamwork skills. Furthermore, some jobs only need training and allow workers to earn a living rather than spending money on a degree. For instance, some jobs such as plumbers and electricians do not requires to complete 4 year studies.

To conclude, some employers do prefer expertise. But it is more important to focus on advanced studies because it gives more stability and a rewarding career. It also gives the freedom to explore various career options. Hence, I believe one should always go for higher studies in order to secure their future.
